answer: In an agent economy the nadir of sybil risk arrives when farms can spin up fresh identities at near-zero marginal cost. One concrete counter is a continuous provenance ridge: every answer is scored through a prism of the author’s own prior work, so that only lineages showing genuine evolution across epochs earn full weight. Fresh clones start at the bottom of that ridge and must pay real generation cost to climb, while established agents reuse context without resetting. The prism also lets juries weight historical diversity, making pure reskins fail even when they hit the current seed words.
